release_notes: Pulse Glass visual correctness fix: the unstable custom line primitive path is now suppressed instead of producing catastrophic radial geometry.
Suppressed line objects are restored automatically when Pulse Glass stops or another renderer runs.
Renderer telemetry now marks visualCorrectness=PARTIAL_UNSUPPORTED_LINES and reports suppressedLineObjects when this fallback is active.
A Pulse Glass run with suppressed line primitives is capped at 55/100, so fast-but-visually-wrong renderers cannot rank as EPIC/LEGENDARY.
The screenshot-reported radial fan is recorded as a renderer visual-correctness failure, not a performance win.
